name: codex-maritime
description: Token-efficient progress updates and remote steering for long-running Codex tasks over Maritime-hosted SMS or messaging channels.

interface.shortDescription: Long-task updates over SMS and WhatsApp.
interface.longDescription: Connect long-running Codex tasks to a Maritime-hosted gateway for deterministic progress summaries, adjustable quiet hours, steering commands, and scoped Y/N approvals.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up progress tracking for this task with Codex Maritime.
